name: golgi associated PDZ and coiled-coil motif containing
pathways: negative regulation of anion channel activity

function.text: GOPC encodes golgi-associated PDZ and coiled-coil motif-containing protein. Annotated molecular activities include molecular sequestering activity and protein homodimerization activity. It participates in negative regulation of anion channel activity and apical protein localization.
